fields.description: Log storefront funnel events (page_view, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase) into this site's own database. Powers the Storefront Analytics dashboard without any external service.
fields.label: Enable First-Party Event Log

fields.description: Send storefront funnel events (PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase) to Meta and read totals back on the Storefront Analytics dashboard. Meta Pixel setup guide
fields.label: Enable Facebook

fields.description: Numeric Dataset (Pixel) ID from Meta Events Manager → Data sources, shown under the dataset name.
fields.label: Facebook Pixel ID

fields.description: Access token of a Business System User with ads_read, ads_management and business_management permissions, plus Full-access assignment to the dataset above. Never expires.
fields.label: Facebook Access Token

fields.description: Send storefront funnel events (page_view, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase) to GA4 and read Sessions/Active Users back on the Storefront Analytics dashboard. Google Analytics 4 setup guide
fields.label: Enable Google Analytics 4

fields.description: Web stream Measurement ID, G-XXXXXXXXXX (Admin → Data Streams → your web stream).
fields.label: GA4 Measurement ID

fields.description: Service-account JSON key. Enable the Google Analytics Data API, then grant the service-account email Viewer on the property (Admin → Property Access Management), else runReport returns 403.
fields.label: GA4 Service Account JSON

fields.description: Arbitrary tracking/tag snippets (Google Tag Manager, PostHog, Hotjar, etc.) injected as-is on every storefront page.
fields.label: Custom Tracking Scripts
